summary: 10.0.38.07 Enterprise DatePicker Engine Parity with Desktop DatePickerFormatter & Company Date Format Setting
highlights: 1. Enterprise Dual-Layer Formatted Datepicker Engine: Upgraded DatePickerFormatter with a synchronized display overlay (.dse-datepicker-display) enforcing company.dateFormat (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy) across all 60+ datepickers.

2. 100% Backend API ISO Compatibility: Decoupled visual formatted presentation from underlying DOM .value (retaining standard YYYY-MM-DD), ensuring backend Spring Boot controllers receive expected ISO dates without exceptions.
3. Real-Time Dynamic Format Synchronization: Listens to dse-date-policy-changed events and instantly updates all active datepickers when the user modifies Date Format in Settings -> Company Profile.
4. Programmatic Value Interception: Overrode property descriptor to ensure JavaScript assignments like input.value = '...' immediately reflect formatted dates on screen.
5. Full Theme & Interaction Parity: Cleaned up native WebKit datetime shadow DOM text masking with transparent styling, visible clickable native calendar icon, and light/dark theme typography.
